# MagicAF — .well-known/llms.txt

https://magicaf.intracav.ai/llms.txt

MagicAF is the open-source Rust AI/ML/NLP framework by Intracav —
embeddings, vector search, LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, and NLP
tooling with zero cloud dependencies, for healthcare and air-gapped
environments.
